name: sosein-staging
description: Collaborate with Sosein's staging artifacts from Codex through the staging Sosein MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate on Sosein staging artifacts from Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Sosein Staging through OAuth-backed MCP. Search and read artifacts, create documents, notes, or records privately or in a workspace, work with structured objects, make block-checked edits, and collaborate through reviews, comments, and suggestions using access delegated from the signed-in user.
